sloka: देव यस्या भयात् रामम् न अनुपृच्चसि सारथिम् ।न इह तिष्ठति कैकेयी विश्रब्धम् प्रतिभाष्यताम् ॥२-५७-३१॥
transliteration: deva yasyā bhayāt rāmam na anupṛccasi sārathim ।na iha tiṣṭhati kaikeyī viśrabdham pratibhāṣyatām ॥2-57-31॥

translations.english: Kaikeyi for fear of whom you dare not ask the charioteer about Rama, O king is not here. You may speak to him without fear.
